epistemic_rules: Every observation stores reference period, collection time, unit and source_id.
Missing bilateral flow is unknown, not zero.
Structural/reference data never confirms a live conflict event.
Commercial-data-derived official analysis must retain the official publication as source and note underlying methodology when known.
